dataset_license.authorization_reason: Repository owner authorized local, non-commercial research training on 2026-10-25 after review of the official source: CREATIS states that the data and ground truth remain publicly available, the download collection is public, and the publisher requires the citation for any use. No licence text is published; the data are not committed or redistributed.
dataset_license.authorization_scope: local non-commercial research training and evaluation; no redistribution of images or masks
dataset_license.name: CREATIS ACDC public research release; mandatory citation; explicit licence terms not published
dataset_license.source: https://www.creatis.insa-lyon.fr/Challenge/acdc/databases.html (download: humanheart-project.creatis.insa-lyon.fr, public collection) and MANDATORY_CITATION.md in the archive
dataset_license.citation: Bernard O, Lalande A, Zotti C, et al. Deep Learning Techniques for Automatic MRI Cardiac Multi-structures Segmentation and Diagnosis: Is the Problem Solved? IEEE TMI 37(11):2514-2525 (2018).

split_method: publisher test patients frozen; development patients split by patient (seed 20261024); development patients whose images duplicate a test patient are excluded

leakage_exclusions.rule: preserve publisher test; exclude the complete development patient linked by identical image SHA-256

selection.criterion: validation mean of case-level macro foreground Dice

config.deterministic_algorithms: warn_only: CUDA nll_loss has no deterministic kernel; repeated CUDA runs can differ slightly

clinical_index_definitions.volumes: voxel count x voxel volume (NIfTI header pixdim) at the publisher's end-diastolic (ED) and end-systolic (ES) frames
clinical_index_definitions.reference: the same indices from the publisher's reference masks (not from clinical reports)

spacing_note: Voxel spacing is read from the NIfTI header pixdim (for example 1.56 x 1.56 x 10 mm); the files' sform affine is unit-scaled.
benchmark_context: Leading entries of the publisher's challenge (Bernard et al., IEEE TMI 2018) reported substantially higher overlap and ejection-fraction agreement; this from-scratch 3-D baseline is not competitive with them. Context only.
determinism: warn_only: CUDA nll_loss has no deterministic kernel; repeated CUDA runs can differ slightly
limitations: Internal held-out evaluation on the publisher's test patients from one centre; no external or clinical validation.
Cardiac indices are compared with indices from the publisher's reference masks, not with clinically reported values.
Native acquisition grid without resampling; slice thickness (5-10 mm) limits through-plane accuracy, and HD95 is dominated by it.

No connected-component post-processing was prespecified; predicted regions away from the heart inflate volumes and HD95, so volumes, ejection fractions and myocardial mass carry large biases and wide limits of agreement.
Evaluation and training used float16 autocast on CUDA; CUDA cross-entropy is not deterministic, so a rerun can differ slightly.
Research-only output; there is no upload inference path, and nothing here is a patient measurement.
